about_the_game:
A tactical equipment supply meticulously curated by expert "Gunsmith" Anna for extreme combat environments. Utilizing selected modification parts, it allows for millimeter-level precision tuning of your weapons to maximize their reliability on the battlefield.

This expansion includes weapons, modification parts, customization spray paints and item purchase authorizations from merchant(s).

  • Weapons：

    • M4A1 5.56x45mm carbine rifle (1 pcs.)

    • M4A1 5.56x45mm carbine rifle max-attach edition (1 pcs.)

  • Modification Parts:

    • AR-15 STR stock (1 pcs.)

    • AR-15 ACE SOCOM buffer tube stock (1 pcs.)

    • AR-15 Delta 9-inch handguard (1 pcs.)

    • AR-15 ARX 12.5-inch handguard (1 pcs.)

    • AR-15 5.56x45mm 508mm barrel (1 pcs.)

    • AR-15 5.56x45mm 368mm barrel (1 pcs.)

  • Spray Paints:

    • Microcosm (1 pcs.)

    • Marine Camo 2 (1 pcs.)

    • Decrypt (1 pcs.)

    • Matrix (1 pcs.)

  • Merchant Store(s)

    • Unlocks 'AR-15 STR stock'

    • Unlocks 'AR-15 Delta 9-inch handguard'

    • Unlocks 'AR-15 5.56x45mm 368mm barrel'

    • Unlocks 'Microcosm' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Marine Camo 2' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Decrypt' spray paint

    • Unlocks 'Matrix' spray paint

Modification parts can be used at the Modification Bench in the Hideout.

Spray paints can be applied to weapons at the Spray Painting Booth in the Hideout.

Items included in this DLC will be sent via multiple in-game mails. Please check your mailbox after purchase to claim your items.

DLC contents will be reissued after each data reset, its actual content is subject to change in future updates.
